Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Meera - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Rishabh stands in the bedroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh yawns loudly.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh stretches his arms above his head.]

Rishabh: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Anjali (gently): "Careful!"

[Rishabh sits on the edge of the bed.]

Anjali (laughing): "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look over here."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The classroom - Day

[Rishabh stands in the classroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Rishabh raises his hand to answer.]

Anjali: "And then?"

[Rishabh writes on the blackboard.]

Rishabh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rishabh reads his book at his desk.]

Anjali (happily): "That's great!"

[Rishabh yawns in the class.]

Anjali: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
